{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: revenue_clean == 999999.99
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of QA orders: {qa_mask.sum()}")

# Filter out QA orders
df_filtered = df[~qa_mask]

# Now count completed orders in the filtered data
completed_count = df_filtered['status'].eq('completed').sum()
print(f"Completed orders (excluding QA): {completed_count}")"}
